name: Line Cut Guard
tip: Press Ctrl+X or Cmd+X with no text selected: the line stays. To cut a whole line on purpose, give the command "Cut selection or line" a hotkey.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Line Cut Guard is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
